protocol.fixedCheckpoints: Entry/final per phase, no best-checkpoint selection
limitations: Thermal initial baseline is not established
Remote control is not navigation/tool composition
No causal isolation of neutral pre-exposure benefit
One order, one new interaction, not universal adaptation

direction: first expanding-world learning and exploration pilot
falsification: Final300k only. Specific new-need acquisition requires on at least2/3 seeds: pressure q>=0.5 against preregistered strongest nonadaptive and joint-active audit means, and pressure improvement over the matched coverage-frozen policy >=0.2 of that audit gap. Full expanding-life adequacy additionally requires an acquired initial thermal skill and retention>=80% of its advantage. Otherwise full adequacy fails. Compare coverage/uniform descriptively per seed; do not infer causal pre-exposure transfer because exploration also differs after need introduction. Commands/both directions or reward alone cannot pass. FreezeAfter100k coverage prefix world/action hashes and entry weights must match coverage. Keep all seeds and final checkpoints; no tuning to this challenge.
statement: A controller frozen before the new workbench was authored can learn a newly valuable non-movement interaction during one continuous life; coverage-guided exploration is assessed separately from external drive motivation.
rationale: The original thermal preflight was behaviorally negative, so retention of an established thermal skill is explicitly not assumed. The new challenge tests genuinely new observation and action slots, a neutral interaction phase, and later an unweighted need. No brain edits after controller-freeze-01.
